summary: Changes go live sooner because jobs now run side by side, and interrupted runs no longer look like failures.

new.title: Jobs run side by side
new.text: Jobs for different areas, such as groups, policies or Azure, now run at the same time. Run now on a busy area is queued and says what it waits for.

new.title: A clearer Jobs page
new.text: Jobs are grouped into Engine, Maintenance, Reports and Updates, with what needs attention first and one line per job with a details panel.

fixes.title: Interrupted runs no longer show as failures
fixes.text: A run cut short by an update or restart now shows grey as interrupted and runs again. Only two interruptions in a row turn red.

fixes.title: Clearer role assignment error
fixes.text: When a role is refused because the group is not role-assignable, PIM Manager now names that cause and the fix.
